svg.aria-label: Flooding broadcast: Every process forwards a message it has not seen, once, to all its neighbours.. ⟨FLOOD, m⟩; first time it sees m: deliver it; ⟨FLOOD, m⟩ to every neighbour; ⟨FLOOD, m⟩ comes back; already seen: drop it. Every connected process is reached, because a message stops only where it has already been.
